title: Tail latency attribution and multi-region adaptive load-shed strategy
creator: Asha Reddy
description: Motivation: Recent incidents showed high token-tail latency during cross-region failover and bursty user traffic. We need a focused instrumentation and dashboard effort that (1) attributes tail token latency to routes/models/regions, (2) exposes actionable golden signals for automated circuit-breakers, and (3) surfaces the current adaptive load-shedding decisions so on-call and SREs can tune policies quickly. Scope: build a token-tail attribution pipeline (p95/p99/p999 by model, route, region), add route-aware token-latency SLI backfills, implement Grafana panels for shed/cb state and simulated canary failovers, and wire alerts that feed an automated rollback/protect policy. Out of scope: changing runtime kernel selection or model quantization profiles — this ticket is instrumentation + dashboards + policy signals only.
acceptance_criteria: Prometheus/ClickHouse query exists for token-level p50/p95/p99/p999 partitioned by model, route and region
Grafana dashboard shows tail-latency attribution with linked slow request examples and top contributing routes
Circuit-breaker state (open/throttled/counts) and recent shed decisions are visible per region and per customer tier
Synthetic canary failover panel simulates region failover and shows expected shed vs observed latency change
Pager alert defined for token-p99 regression > 30% vs baseline and circuit-breaker misfires (false-open rate > 2%)
Runbook updated with steps to toggle shed policy and rollback model variants; on-call validated procedures in a dry-run
metrics_and_queries: promql: sum by(model, route, region) (histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, model, route, region)))
clickhouse: SELECT model, route, region, quantileExact(0.99)(token_ms) AS p99_ms FROM tokens WHERE ts >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR GROUP BY model, route, region ORDER BY p99_ms DESC LIMIT 50
promql: sum by(region) (rate(load_shed_decision_total[5m])) / sum by(region) (rate(request_incoming_total[5m])) AS shed_ratio
dashboard_panels: Token tail map: heatmap of p99-p999 token latency by model (rows) and region (columns) with hover to open sample request trace
Top contributing routes: bar chart of routes sorted by contribution to p99 token latency (delta vs baseline) over 1h/24h
Circuit breaker state matrix: current state (CLOSED/HALF_OPEN/OPEN), last_changed, open_count by region and by customer tier
Load-shed explanations: timeline of shed decisions with policy input (load, cpu, queue-length) and percent of requests shed per minute
Canary failover simulator: synthetic probe latency plus expected shed ratio; ability to toggle simulate-region-down to validate automatic routing
Alerting panel: recent alerts for token-p99 regressions, cb misfires, and shed_ratio breaches with links to incidents and runbook steps

Long-term: evaluate streaming reservoir quantiles to reduce aggregation error. Incident learnings from INC-2026-02-28 influenced adding p999 telemetry and synthetic failover probes.
